items.name: DeltaWriter
items.summary: Trait for writing data to Delta tables

methods.name: flush
methods.signature: async fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<Add>, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Flush the internal write buffers to files in the delta table folder structure. The corresponding delta [`Add`] actions are returned and should be committed via a transaction.

methods.name: flush_and_commit
methods.signature: async fn flush_and_commit(&mut self, table: &mut DeltaTable) -> Result<Version, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Flush the internal write buffers to files in the delta table folder structure. and commit the changes to the Delta log, creating a new table version.

methods.name: write
methods.signature: async fn write(&mut self, values: T) -> Result<(), DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Write a chunk of values into the internal write buffers with the default write mode

methods.name: write_with_mode
methods.signature: async fn write_with_mode(&mut self, values: T, mode: WriteMode) -> Result<(), DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Wreite a chunk of values into the internal write buffers with the specified [WriteMode]
